summary: OVHcloud Startup Program: the 12-month Start level gives €10,000 of free cloud credits + 6 hours of 1-on-1 engineer time + visibility; the 12-month Scale level gives up to €100,000 of free cloud credits + up to 20 hours of engineer time. For early-stage startups and scaleups by application.
claim_steps: Apply at startup.ovhcloud.com for the Start or Scale level.
On acceptance, receive 12 months of credits (€10,000 Start / up to €100,000 Scale) plus engineer 1-on-1 time.

social_proof.title: OVHcloud Startup Program
social_proof.text: Our 12-month Start level offers you: €10,000 of free cloud credits, 6 hours of 1-on-1 time with an engineer (free). Our 12-month Scale level offers you: Up to €100,000 of free cloud credits, up to 20 hours of 1-on-1 time with an engineer (free).
